name: What is hydro-jetting and when is it used for toilet clogs?

mainEntity.name: What is hydro-jetting and when is it used for toilet clogs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hydro-jetting is a powerful drain cleaning method that uses high-pressure water streams to blast away stubborn clogs, grease buildup, tree roots, and other debris from pipes. It's often used when traditional snaking isn't effective or when there's a recurring clog indicating significant buildup in the main sewer line. While not typically needed for a simple toilet clog, it's a valuable solution for comprehensive pipe cleaning that can prevent future blockages. CG Plumbing Solutions uses hydro-jetting for more extensive plumbing issues, offering a thorough cleaning compared to just breaking through a blockage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hydro-jetting uses high-pressure water to clear severe clogs, grease, and roots from pipes, typically for main sewer line issues when snaking isn't enough.
